title: Verify Arch Linux ISO signature
summary: Check the digital signature of the downloaded Arch Linux ISO file to ensure it is authentic and has not been tampered with.
prerequisites: Existing Arch Linux installation or GPG keys set up

steps.explain: Run pacman-key to verify the signature of the ISO file. Replace <VERSION> with the actual version number of the ISO.

placeholders.name: VERSION
placeholders.description: The version number of the downloaded ISO, e.g., 2023.05.01

steps.expect: Output indicating the signature is good and trusted.
